# ADR-0008: Audio stimuli are generated by GPL.Stimuli (2026-11-09)

Status: **accepted** (PO 2026-11-09: "do the GPL.Stimuli ... then, update the project to use GPL.Stimuli"; C01 / C03 keep the
recordings until the PO replaces them; HW2's stimulus moves to GPL.Stimuli)

**Context.** Every chamber used HW2's files in `Chambers/HumPerHW2/Audio` (a link between chambers, rule 1). `SFX-C-01` (white noise)
was imported as Vorbis, which changes level, band and waveform of a noise stimulus. Two background files are 246 MB of podcasts from
YouTube in a public repository. Tones and noise are fully described by a few numbers, so a file adds size, a codec risk and a licence
question but no information. The lab's stimulus catalog (2026-11-09) listed the published stimuli and their parameters.

**Decision**
- A portable module **GPL.Stimuli** generates tones and Gaussian white / pink noise from a `StimulusRecipe` (duration, cos² or linear
  ramps, RMS level before the ramps, seed, band, sample rate) into an in-memory PCM `AudioClip`, once at chamber load.
- Defaults: Gaussian; pink by frequency-domain shaping, 20 Hz-20 kHz (exact -3 dB/octave); cos² ramps 10 ms; -26 dBFS RMS;
  48 kHz (the device output rate at run time); a fixed seed (frozen token), a token bank (seeds 1..N, token logged) when a design
  asks for variety. A chamber's design may change any of them.
- A chamber logs the recipe (`StimulusRecipe.Note()`), not a file name. Studies take recipe values from presets (ADR-0002);
  experience chambers keep them as design constants (ADR-0006).
- Recordings stay files, imported as PCM (Decompress On Load; long backgrounds may stream), with a credit entry (ADR-0009):
  shared ones in the module's **`Library/`** (catalog `StimulusLibrary`, files unchanged, level set at load by
  `StimulusClips.Leveled`), chamber-only ones in the chamber's own `Audio/` (PO 2026-11-09: "download the audio files ... for the
  files you can get legally, and add to GPL.Stimuli library"). Only recordings that may be redistributed go into the library
  (research-only Aalto horn tracks: tried and rolled back, PO 2026-11-09: not meaningful for the research).
- Placement and playback stay in GPL.SpatialSources; GPL.Stimuli only makes clips.

**Consequences**
- HiddenSource and HumPerHW2 play a generated 2 s white noise (20 ms cos² ramps, -26 dBFS RMS ≈ -22.9 LUFS by calculation, seed 1)
  instead of `SFX-C-01`. HearingLoss and MovingSource offer generated White noise and Pink noise, then the three HW2 recordings
  (temporary, PO will replace them). HearingLoss tones use the module (same level and length as before).
- Scenes keep a reference to `SFX-C-01` until the chamber's Step 2 (HW2: Step 4) is run again; Validate Setup reports it.
- `SFX-C-01` is no longer used by code; the PO decides when to delete it with HW2's other files.
- Not measured yet: render time on the Quest (Editor: the 2^18-sample pink loop 61 ms, a 4 s pink clip about 0.4 s), the level at
  the ear (dB SPL), LUFS of the generated files (calculated only).
- Library 2026-11-09: 7 OpenAIR recordings (CC BY-SA, in git). No chamber uses
  them yet. OpenAIR's speech (the lab's Q032 female voice) is not in the CC BY-SA snapshot.
- The catalog (`docs/references/AUDIO_STIMULI_CATALOG.md`) and HW2's `Audio/README.md` were merged into the module README; the PO
  removes the originals.
